plugin.name: Skyrim SE 1.5.97 or AE 1.6.1170
plugin.description: For Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 and Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 3.7.0, which reads Address Library formats 1 and 2.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.99 / 1.7.104 (current Steam version)
plugin.description: For Skyrim 1.7.99 and 1.7.104. Needs SKSE 2.3.x and Address Library All-in-One v13 or newer. Built on CommonLibSSE-NG 7.2.0; this DLL is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later (licence texts install with it).

group.name: Which compass movie should be used?

plugin.name: This mod's compass (recommended)
plugin.description: Installs Compass Navigation Overhaul's own compass movie (Interface\InfinityUI\HUDMenu\HUDMovieBaseInstance\CompassShoutMeterHolder\Compass.swf). Pick this unless another mod gives you that file.

plugin.name: Use the compass from another mod
plugin.description: Leaves the compass movie out, for when another mod supplies Compass Navigation Overhaul's Compass.swf with its own art - for example Vibrant Map Markers (its main file, or its Dear Diary Dark Mode, Untarnished UI or Dragonbreaker UI compass file). Without such a mod the compass stays vanilla, so only pick this if you have one. Choosing the first option and letting that mod overwrite this one in your mod manager works too.
